from pathlib import Path
import textwrap
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs')
base.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    width = len(g[0])
    barrier = next((r for r, row in enumerate(g) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row)), len(g))
    top = g[0]
    bottom = g[-1]
    color = next((v for v in top if v != 0), None)
    if color is None:
        return g
    top_cols = {c for c, v in enumerate(top) if v == color}
    bottom_cols = {c for c, v in enumerate(bottom) if v == color}
    cols = top_cols & bottom_cols
    for r in range(1, barrier):
        for c in cols:
            g[r][c] = 4
    return g
'''
